aboutGame.title: What is Build a Dungeon?
paragraphs: Build a Dungeon is an immersive fantasy dungeon building and management simulator where players step into the role of an underground architect. Design lethal subterranean labyrinths, excavate treasure vaults, place cunning mechanical traps, and garrison vicious monsters to defend your dungeon core against invading adventurers.

Balance critical resource economies including Gold, Mana, and Food while expanding your territory, optimizing intruder pathfinding, and unlocking advanced room archetypes. Our community wiki provides verified mechanics guides, layout blueprints, code updates, and tactical tips to help you rule the underworld.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Build a Dungeon.

items.question: What is Build a Dungeon?
items.answer: Build a Dungeon is a fantasy dungeon building and management simulator where players excavate underground lairs, place lethal traps, recruit monsters, and protect their central core against waves of invading adventurers.

items.question: How do you defend your core in Build a Dungeon?
items.answer: Defending your core in Build a Dungeon requires funneling raiders through serpentine corridors, controlling chokepoints with spike and dart traps, and stationing powerful monster guards to ambush weakened heroes.

items.question: Where can I find active Build a Dungeon codes?
items.answer: You can find the latest working Build a Dungeon codes on our dedicated Codes page, providing free bonus gold, premium gems, summon tokens, and building supplies.

items.question: What resources are most important in Build a Dungeon?
items.answer: The three foundational resources in Build a Dungeon are Gold for excavating and building chambers, Mana for fueling spells and traps, and Food to feed minions and keep morale high.

items.question: Can you play Build a Dungeon with friends in multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes, Build a Dungeon includes cooperative defense and raid mechanics allowing friends to construct shared strongholds and test defensive gauntlets together.
